services.desc: No sharks. No pressure. Just easy games with people who are learning the same things you are. Show up, get put on a court, and play games to 11 with rotating partners. Everybody here is new-ish, so nobody is keeping score of your mistakes. If you've never held a paddle, someone will walk you through it before your first game. Built for brand new players and anyone around 3.0. Casual players only - the 4.5s have their own courts on other nights.
